
### multiple names, one IP


<pre><code>$ <em>dig +short es.wikipedia.org aaaa</em>
dyna.wikimedia.org.
2620:0:860:ed1a::1
$ <em>dig +short en.wikipedia.org aaaa</em>
dyna.wikimedia.org.
2620:0:860:ed1a::1
</code></pre>
 

* es.wikipedia.org = Spanish Wikipedia
* en.wikipedia.org = English Wikipedia
* how does this work?


### Host/:authority header


* when getting http://somehostname/path, send header
* <code>Host: somehostname</code> (HTTP/1.1)
* <code>:authority: somehostname</code> (HTTP/2, HTTP/3) 
<hr class="vspace" />
* allows for ‘virtual hosts’
